texts.sp_offline: Ayikho i-inthanethi. Izimpendulo zakho zihlala kulolu cingo futhi zithunyelwa uma i-inthanethi ibuya.
texts.sp_side_note: Imiphumela ivela kusukela ezimpendulweni ezingu-5. Impendulo engenagama ayikaze ikhombise ukuthi ngubani oyinikezile.
texts.title: I-LynkSurvey ocingweni lwakho
